Results.Title: Important! Competition Patch 2.0 required from November 19th 2026
Results.Message:
An important update regarding the [b]TrackMania Competition Patch[/b]:

From November 19th 2026, it is required to have installed the latest version of the TrackMania Competition Patch in order to be eligible to upload replays to any [b]Nadeo[/b], [b]Star[/b] or [b]Classic[/b] track.

[b]Version 2.0[/b] is released as of this post, November 4th 2026, and must be installed in order to upload your replays going forward. You can download the latest version of the patch [url=https://donadigo.com/tmcp][b]here[/b][/url].

You can read more about the patch and ask any questions in the [url=https://tmuf.exchange/threadshow/7281624?&postId=7281625][b]forum announcement post[/b][/url].

Results.Title: New Screenshots Rule - Banning Generative AI
Results.Message:
We've noticed that some people have chosen to use generative AI for their track screenshots here on :tmx:. These images misrepresent the track. Therefore, we've added a new rule to the rules page prohibiting the use of generative AI in track screenshots. Old tracks will be grandfathered in, but any new tracks uploaded after July 4, 2026 should abide by this rule.

Thanks for your attention in this matter.

Kind regards,
:tmx: crew
